judged_text: PollFeed assumes every feed item has a `content` element, but RSS 2.0 feeds put the body in `description`, so `i.content` is nil and `i.content.scrub` raises NoMethodError. For any RSS 2.0 feed (the most common format), the hourly job crashes on the first item with NoMethodError; because sidekiq_options retry: false is set, no retry happens and zero topics are ever imported, with no per-item rescue so one malformed item also aborts import of all remaining items every run.

For any RSS 2.0 feed (the most common format), the hourly job crashes on the first item with NoMethodError; because sidekiq_options retry: false is set, no retry happens and zero topics are ever imported, with no per-item rescue so one malformed item also aborts import of all remaining items every run.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, the job does `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`. This unconditionally assumes `i.content` is non-nil and responds to `scrub`. If a parsed feed item lacks a `content` field (common for RSS 2.0 where body is typically in `description`), this will raise `NoMethodError` and abort the entire `rss.items.each` loop because there is no per-item rescue. The job also sets `sidekiq_options retry: false`, so a crash won’t be retried by Sidekiq.
